summary: Every golden operation is present with the right press, shut height, dimension, weld setting, torque, tack count and coating thickness. The header Stage No. is the operation-code range “PP-010 to PP-130” and the line area drops UNIT-3. The operator also gets 24 critical additions from the PPAP (min shut heights, strokes, pressures, extra CD dimensions, F-PRD-17, sampling frequencies) and vaguer rework actions than the golden (no rust remover, no plastic mallet, no part-shift row).
